description_en: Shares a custom image with other Alibaba Cloud accounts in the same region to quickly deploy the same environment configurations for multiple simple application servers at a time. This improves deployment efficiency
description_zh: 您可以将自定义镜像共享给同地域下的其他阿里云账号，快速为多个轻量应用服务器部署相同的环境配置，提高部署效率
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open add-custom-image-share-account --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-saacssasc0000 --account 1251114252330000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCustomImageShareAccount

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom image
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Alibaba Cloud accounts with which you want to share the custom image
parameters.name: account
